Best Research AI Tools

7 research AI tools, compared by features, pricing and rating. Open any tool for details and similar alternatives.

AI tools in this category

  • Elicit: AI research assistant that automates systematic literature reviews and research tasks.
  • Consensus: AI search engine for scientific research. Find consensus across millions of peer-reviewed papers.
  • Scite AI: Smart citation tool that shows how papers have been cited with supporting and contrasting evidence.
  • Humata: Ask questions of long PDFs and documents and get answers with page-level citations.
  • NotebookLM: Google's research notebook: upload your sources and get grounded answers, summaries and audio overviews.
  • Perplexity Labs: Research mode that builds reports, spreadsheets and dashboards from live web sources.
  • Semantic Scholar: Free AI-powered academic search with paper summaries and citation graphs.
